extracted.intended_audience: mathematics researchers, prospective workshop organizers, participants, and applicants to BIRS programs
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional landing page summarizing Banff International Research Station (BIRS) programs, event types, administrative resources, and links to applicant/organizer procedures and policies. Serves prospective organizers, participants, and applicants seeking submission/review/participation guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIRS Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage lists the Code of Conduct as a resource; the detailed conduct standards/rules are not included on this page (follow the link for full policy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines (For Applicants)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that applicants must follow published guidelines when preparing proposals; the homepage only references the guidelines and does not include the detailed submission rules or evaluation criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Submission Form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A procedural requirement for submitting proposals to BIRS; full form fields and submission requirements are on the linked form rather than this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Review Process / Proposal Review System
rubrics_metrics.description: Links/sections titled 'The Review Process' and 'Proposal Review System'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that proposals undergo a review process; the homepage references the review system but does not present the specific review criteria, scoring rubric, or reviewer guidance (see linked pages for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for Organizers and Participants
rubrics_metrics.description: Link/section 'Resources for Organizers and Participants' including items like 'Add Participants', 'Participant List Submission/Status', 'Enter your Schedule'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points to logistical/procedural resources and required actions for organizers and participants; the homepage lists these functions but does not contain their procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant invitation response procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that participants must formally accept or decline invitations via the provided process; exact deadlines, formats, and expectations are on the linked page/interface.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant list and scheduling requirements (organizers/participants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links such as 'Participant List Submission/Status' and 'Enter your Schedule'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates organizers/participants are required to submit participant lists and schedules through BIRS systems; the homepage references these requirements but does not include the submission format or timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs and event-type descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Section listing program types: Workshops (2-day, 5-day), Focused Research Groups, Research in Teams, Summer Schools, Public Lectures, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies the kinds of events BIRS runs; the homepage lists program categories but does not provide the eligibility, selection criteria, or format-specific rules (follow program pages for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for Equity, Diversity and Inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Link/section 'Resources for Equity, Diversity and Inclusion'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage references EDI resources and initiatives; the substantive EDI policies, expectations, and implementation guidance are on the linked resource pages.
